foundation.operator_fixture: Measured fresh camera height alignment, captured sensor target lock, then measured confirmed-full insertion before lifting. Truth depth is a test assertion/scripted operator stopping condition, not autonomous feedback.

precision_comparison.scope: Same DLL, sensed target-lock operator fixture, 480Hz/16 parallel vs 960Hz/32 serial. This is a numerical profile comparison, not OEM calibration.

actual.source: actual Unreal fleet HTTP frames; no synthetic ingest

browser_visual_qa.reason: Computer-use tool could not determine current browser URL and stopped browser interaction. Not retried through another UI tool.

Assumed box geometry has four-direction tine corridors
layout.scope: Authored layout, assumed pallet prism geometry and reserved graph only. Not forklift motion, multi-vehicle throughput, load rating, charging or four-way sensing qualification.

limits: Observed FPS values are end-of-case smoothed readings, not average FPS or an Editor Play real-time guarantee.
480Hz/16 profile peak total wheel contact force differs by about 11.6% from 960Hz/32 in the compared operator fixture; use precision mode for impact/load comparisons.
Reservation policy favors conservative sequential access over throughput; only three vehicles qualified.
Known surveyed stations and approaches, no arbitrary pallet identity/orientation optimization or overhead 3D safety classification.
Numerical/specification assumptions remain distinct from measured real-vehicle calibration.

rejected_trials.reason: Conservative docking fringe hit; corrected compact docking sweep.
Loaded rotation envelope too close to rack after withdrawal; rack pickup withdrawal extended by 0.25m.
Manual fixture did not confirm measured full insertion; updated sensed alignment/target-lock operator fixture, without weakening final full/lift/support assertions.
Validation alignment input freshness was incomplete; corrected exact camera sequence check.
Validation insertion did not retain sensed target; added same measured target lock used by production docking and full confirmation before lift.

startup_note: Interactive editor map load and responsiveness confirmed without starting Play. Three generic AutomationTest Condition failed messages occurred before engine initialization; project unit report is separately 98/98 and no clean-engine-log claim is made.
